links.excerpt: Israel says 91 hostages abducted on Oct. 7 remain in captivity, including the bodies of at least 34.

stories.title: ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment
stories.summary: AI researcher Yoshua Bengio says mounting safety concerns are bringing regulation closer to a Covid-style turning point. He argues that a safety crisis could spur governments to act to protect the public. The Guardian describes Bengio as one of the technology’s “godfathers.”

links.headline: ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment
